objective.claim: develop a separately attributable London-fix FX pressure system that beats exact V8

primary_evidence.title: Did the Reform Fix the London Fix Problem?
Equity hedging and exchange rates at the London 4 p.m. fix
Minutes of the London FXJSC Main Committee Meeting - 13 March 2025

evidence_transfer_limit: the literature motivates only benchmark-linked pressure and possible pre/post-fix predictability; it does not validate FPMarkets M1 bars, exact direction, clocks, stops, costs, USD 100 capacity or any V8 gate

known_prior_families: target-index barriers, residual baskets and learned target-return models
material_distinctions: direct positions in four FX pairs rather than an index target or external-to-target transfer
institutional 16:00 London benchmark execution pressure rather than exchange opening or US equity close
two fixed pre/post-fix phases rather than an outcome-selected clock or hold
short complete M1 event lifecycles rather than multi-week channels or learned generic return labels
closed_neighborhoods_excluded: Family 009 channel, ATR, stop, hold, symbol, direction, priority, risk or sizing rescue
Family 008 QQQ/TQQQ coherence, magnitude, rank, close clock or exit rescue
Family 006 London or New York opening-anchor response rescue
V1-V8 signal, opportunity, state, trade or component economics

source.development_request: 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z/2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in broker raw wall-clock encoding, with adapter true-UTC filtering
source.price_basis: broker-native Bid OHLC; row spread times point reconstructs Ask
source.acquisition: fresh copy_rates_range through the family-owned dedicated Portable only after declaration reaches origin/main
source.atomicity: persist no final family source unless all four M1 files and specifications complete and pass integrity
source.locked_2026: not requested, acquired or opened until one unchanged complete development passer exists

raw_time_semantics.source_encoding: connected-broker server wall-clock encoded as Unix-like epoch seconds, not semantic UTC
raw_time_semantics.normalization: render raw integer as timezone-naive wall clock, attach Europe/Helsinki with IANA rules, convert to true UTC, then convert to Europe/London
raw_time_semantics.bar_cadence: require exact consecutive local M1 timestamps for every frozen event interval; do not synthesize gaps

complete_event_geometry.reason: one prior close for continuation ATR, both signal/lifecycle intervals and all audit horizons through the 30th reversal held bar close
complete_event_geometry.portfolio_active_date: a true judged-period date with exact common geometry in all four symbols; an equality/no-direction date remains in the turnover denominator
complete_event_geometry.incomplete_date: exclude before any signal value or outcome
complete_event_geometry.month_end_audit_slice: retrospectively label the last complete active date in each London calendar month; audit-only and never an admission rule
complete_event_geometry.quarter_end_audit_slice: month-end audit date in March, June, September or December; audit-only

features.true_range: maximum of Bid high-low, absolute Bid high-prior observed close and absolute Bid low-prior observed close
features.ATR20: arithmetic mean of twenty completed M1 true ranges ending on the variant decision bar
features.risk_distance: maximum of five times frozen ATR20 and four times entry-row observed spread times point

variants.direction: LONG when strictly positive, SHORT when strictly negative, no trade on equality
SHORT when strictly positive, LONG when strictly negative, no trade on equality

lifecycle.entry: direction-specific market entry at the exact frozen local M1 open
lifecycle.hard_stop: fixed at entry execution price plus or minus one risk distance; never widened or trailed
lifecycle.long_stop: entry Ask minus risk distance, evaluated on Bid low
lifecycle.short_stop: entry Bid plus risk distance, evaluated on Ask high
lifecycle.same_bar_entry_and_stop: entry occurs at bar open and adverse hard stop wins
lifecycle.time_exit: after hard-stop evaluation in every held bar, close direction-specifically at the frozen next-open timestamp

position_and_portfolio_risk.risk_per_lot: risk distance divided by trade tick size times trade_tick_value_loss
position_and_portfolio_risk.volume_rounding: floor target-risk lots to volume step and maximum; use minimum lot only when planned stop loss is at most three percent of actual balance snapshot
position_and_portfolio_risk.same_timestamp_snapshot: one post-prior-exit actual-balance snapshot for all four ranked entries
position_and_portfolio_risk.aggregate_reservation: sum sequentially accepted original planned stop losses and reject a new entry above eight percent of the snapshot
position_and_portfolio_risk.insolvency_or_nonfinite_actual_balance: block later entries without rewriting completed lifecycles

quote_cost_and_swap.Ask: Bid plus row spread times point
quote_cost_and_swap.money_conversion: directional price distance divided by tick size times profit tick value for a gain or loss tick value for a loss times volume
quote_cost_and_swap.actual_spread: one direction-specific observed spread through Bid/Ask execution
quote_cost_and_swap.extra_stress: subtract that lifecycle's observed direction-specific spread burden once more
quote_cost_and_swap.swap: apply signed freshly acquired broker swap only for an actually crossed eligible broker rollover boundary; any expected intraday lifecycle crossing one aborts as geometry fault
supported_swap_modes: CURRENCY_SYMBOL when exact USD conversion exists

improvement_potential_audit.population: every complete nonzero signal in both variants whether admitted or blocked
values: one-lot raw gross, actual and stressed close R
raw Bid MFE and MAE R
ordinary versus last-complete-month-end and quarter-end descriptive slices
observed and doubled spread burden plus any swap
hard-stop versus time-exit attribution and truncation
improvement_potential_audit.broad_headroom_definition: at one frozen horizon from 5/10/20/25/30 M1, mean raw-gross and stressed R are both positive in each development year, at least three symbols, both directions, ordinary dates and last-complete-month-end dates, with at least eight signals per required slice
improvement_potential_audit.decision_rule: complete both variants and the audit before closure; a broad result may retain one bounded seed but cannot execute it inside V1
improvement_potential_audit.audit_authority_limit: cannot authorize a clock, window, threshold, month-end filter, pair, direction, ATR, stop, hold, risk or sizing variant

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net, then frozen variant order

python_adapter_owns: complete event geometry, ATR20, risk distance and directions
same-timestamp sequence and proxy portfolio reservation
ea_must_own: schema, variant, sequence and freshness validation
all four symbol contract, tick, lot, swap and market-state validation
balance-based volume, minimum-lot and aggregate risk caps
hard stop, timed exit and bounded execution evidence

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged variant is selected from complete development passers and then passes locked and whole proxy gates
required: family-owned Python adapter and byte-pinned four-symbol decision tape
one dedicated-Portable MT5 Every tick based on real ticks path

ordered_stages: declaration before runtime, M1/specification acquisition, features, directions, implementation or economics
fresh development-only four-symbol M1 acquisition and complete specifications
complete adapter implementation and outcome-free source/event/turnover/minimum-lot precheck
freeze exact implementation before any future path or lifecycle
one complete two-variant development bundle plus mandatory improvement audit
locked 2026 acquisition and confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained Python adapter plus EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.one_variant_failure: continue the frozen sibling and improvement audit
stop_rules.no_development_passer_and_no_broad_headr: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5
stop_rules.no_development_passer_but_broad_headroom: record one bounded successor seed only; do not execute it inside V1 and recompare the whole autonomous method map
stop_rules.confirmation_or_whole_proxy_failure: close before EA and MT5 after recording the audit
stop_rules.environment_source_design_or_engineering: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires separate user-authorized engineering and handoff
